主要内容: The Royal Bank of Canada issued a Form 6-K report on January 11, 2012, detailing the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E. These notes were linked to specific securities, including Airbag Yield Optimization Notes tied to a single common stock and Reverse Convertible Notes linked to Apple Inc. The report outlines the pricing and settlement dates for these notes, with the latter having a principal amount of $695,000. The document also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The report is incorporated by reference into the Bank’s registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806).
